V. 2.
He taught them many things by parables—After the uſual Manner of the Eaſtern Nations, to make his Inſtructions more agreeable to them, and to impreſs them the more upon attentive Hearers. A Parable ſignifies not only a Simile or Compariſon, and ſometimes a Proverb, but any Kind of inſtructive Speech, wherein ſpiritual Things are explained and illuſtrated by natural. Prov. i. 6. To underſtand a proverb and the interpretation—The Proverb is the literal Senſe, the Interpretation is the ſpiritual; reſting in the literal Senſe killeth, but the ſpiritual giveth Life.
